017package org.apache.juneau.bean.html5;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
020
021/**
022 * DTO for an HTML <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/edits.html#the-del-element">&lt;del&gt;</a>
023 * element.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * The del element represents text that has been deleted from a document. It is typically rendered
027 * with a strikethrough effect to indicate that the content has been removed. The cite and datetime
028 * attributes can be used to provide information about when and why the deletion occurred.
029 *
030 * <h5 class='section'>Examples:</h5>
031 * <p class='bcode w800'>
032 *    <jk>import static</jk> org.apache.juneau.bean.html5.HtmlBuilder.*;
033 *
034 *    <jc>// Simple deleted text</jc>
035 *    Del <jv>del1</jv> = <jsm>del</jsm>(<js>"This text has been removed."</js>);
036 *
037 *    <jc>// Deleted text with citation and timestamp</jc>
038 *    Del <jv>del2</jv> = <jsm>del</jsm>()
039 *       .cite(<js>"https://example.com/revision-log"</js>)
040 *       .datetime(<js>"2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"</js>)
041 *       .text(<js>"Outdated information removed"</js>);
042 *
043 *    <jc>// Deleted text with reason</jc>
044 *    Del <jv>del3</jv> = <jsm>del</jsm>()
045 *       .cite(<js>"https://example.com/corrections"</js>)
046 *       .datetime(<js>"2024-01-15"</js>)
047 *       .text(<js>"Incorrect statement"</js>)
048 *       .title(<js>"Removed due to factual error"</js>);
049 * </p>
050 *
051 * <p>
052 * The following convenience methods are provided for constructing instances of this bean:
053 * <ul class='javatree'>
054 *    <li class='jc'>{@link HtmlBuilder}
055 *    <ul class='javatree'>
056 *       <li class='jm'>{@link HtmlBuilder#del() del()}
057 *       <li class='jm'>{@link HtmlBuilder#del(Object...) del(Object...)}
058 *    </ul>
059 * </ul>
060 * </p>
061 *
062 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
063 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauBeanHtml5">juneau-bean-html5</a>
064 * </ul>
065 */
066@Marshalled(typeName = "del")
067public class Del extends HtmlElementMixed<Del> {
068
069   /**
070    * Creates an empty {@link Del} element.
071    */
072   public Del() {}
073
074   /**
075    * Creates a {@link Del} element with the specified {@link Del#children(Object[])} node.
076    *
077    * @param children The {@link Del#children(Object[])} node. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
078    */
079   public Del(Object...children) {
080      children(children);
081   }
082
083   /**
084    * <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/edits.html#attr-mod-cite">cite</a> attribute.
085    *
086    * <p>
087    * Specifies the URL of a document that explains the reason for the deletion.
088    * This provides context and justification for the edit.
089    *
090    * <p>
091    * The URL should point to a document that explains why the content was deleted.
092    *
093    * @param value The URL explaining the reason for the deletion. Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the attribute.
094    * @return This object.
095    */
096   public Del cite(String value) {
097      attr("cite", value);
098      return this;
099   }
100
101   /**
102    * <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/edits.html#attr-mod-datetime">datetime</a> attribute.
103    *
104    * <p>
105    * Specifies the date and time when the content was deleted. Used for tracking
106    * the history of document changes.
107    *
108    * <p>
109    * The value should be a valid date-time string in ISO 8601 format.
110    *
111    * @param value The date and time when the content was deleted. Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the attribute.
112    * @return This object.
113    */
114   public Del datetime(String value) {
115      attr("datetime", value);
116      return this;
117   }
118
119}
